real_task: Complete the mandatory startup reading for Session 022 before selecting work.
observed_problem: Session 020's combined startup read produced one transport truncation warning and required a recovery read.
baseline: The observed Session 020 combined-read attempt produced one warning; its exact total calls and elapsed time were not captured comparably.
hypothesis: Separate bounded reads with explicit EOF markers reduce truncation-warning outputs from 1 to 0 while delivering the mandatory document scope.
quality_control: AGENTS, README, ROADMAP and STATE fit their declared line ranges; the scoped recent SESSIONS tail, complete DECISIONS and complete EXPERIMENT_POLICY reads reach explicit EOF markers before the gate runs.
overhead_to_count: Read-call count, EOF markers, report/document maintenance and checkpoint refresh; do not translate bytes or warning counts into tokens or decision quality.
stop_condition: One natural startup use only; add no reader or context pack. Revisit only after another real incomplete-read incident.

overhead.baseline: At least the failed combined read plus a recovery read; exact comparable call/time/token totals were not recorded.
overhead.intervention: Four read outputs before selection, three EOF markers, then this trace, field report, session documentation and checkpoint maintenance.

limitations: The runs occurred in different sessions with different document sizes and tool-response conditions.
Baseline elapsed time, tokens and exact total calls are unavailable, so end-to-end overhead is not comparable.
Complete delivery and zero warnings do not establish comprehension or a better task decision.
This is one natural use after one earlier failure.
result.reason: The practice avoided the prior transport symptom and preserved document completeness, but no end-to-end agent benefit can be attributed. Keep the one-line practice and build nothing.
